meta.name: Life Ledger — Reference Dashboard Motion DNA
meta.description: Design and motion DNA extracted from the user-provided 188.7-second dashboard-menu reference video. Use principles and interaction behavior, not literal branding or a wholesale copy of all six menu patterns.

color.palette_type: neutral foundation with one contextual accent per state

secondary.role: calm Life Ledger identity and positive completion

accent.role: rare high-attention selection and live-state accent inspired by the reference

neutral.usage: warm canvas, quiet cards, separators, secondary labels, primary ink

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-warm-light with a dark navigation rail; accent is sparse and never carries meaning alone

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Display, PingFang SC, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, PingFang SC, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Editorial scale contrast with restrained headings; tabular figures for timers and analytics; no tiny decorative uppercase copy.

spacing.section_rhythm: 8–12px inside controls, 16–20px inside cards, 24–32px between functional zones

layout.max_content_width: none inside the native window; use pane constraints and readable measures
layout.columns: sidebar 196–236px; primary canvas 7–8 columns; contextual rail 4–5 columns; stack secondary content below 1080px
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with asymmetrical emphasis on the current task

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px separators and state outlines; avoid card soup
shape.divider_style: hairline semantic separators, draggable pane dividers with larger invisible hit area

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused only for floating command palette, menus and transient overlays
elevation.depth_cues: overlap, scrim/blur for modal command surfaces, borders and tonal surface shifts for inline content

iconography.style: consistent rounded outline symbols with filled selected state only where useful

motion.entrance_pattern: emerge from trigger, transform/opacity only, preserve shared-element continuity
motion.exit_pattern: same spatial origin, 60–70% of entrance duration
motion.philosophy: dynamic means immediate, causal and continuous—not constant decoration

components.button_style: quiet ghost/tonal controls with instant hover, subtle 0.97 press scale, visible focus ring and clear selected state
components.input_style: native-feeling fields with visible labels, compact radius, high-contrast focus and no placeholder-only semantics
components.card_style: few purposeful dashboard modules with varied spans, explicit hierarchy and stable reserved geometry
components.navigation_pattern: persistent macOS sidebar with one sliding active highlight, optional single inline expansion, plus command palette
components.modal_style: anchored popover from trigger or centered command palette with 45–55% scrim and restrained blur
components.list_style: full-row targets with persistent selection, contextual actions on hover/focus and keyboard parity
components.component_notes: Do not combine sidebar, top mega-nav and floating dock at the same hierarchy. Select one coherent navigation system.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a responsive personal control surface whose pieces reorganize around the current task
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary productivity dashboard with editorial Swiss grid discipline

visual_language.whitespace_usage: functional breathing room; no empty deserts and no cramped inspector
visual_language.focal_strategy: single current-task focal zone with secondary modules progressively disclosed
visual_language.contrast_level: clear surface and type hierarchy without harsh black/yellow domination

composition.hierarchy_method: span, scale, density and spatial isolation before color
composition.flow_direction: sidebar selection → primary work canvas → contextual action/insight rail
composition.grouping_strategy: few large functional zones; related micro-controls share one surface
composition.negative_space_role: separates tasks and supports reading, never substitutes for missing content

imagery.photo_treatment: personal photos use stable 4:3/1:1 frames, object-fit cover, meaningful empty state and contextual editing
imagery.illustration_style: none by default; use functional charts and familiar symbols
imagery.graphic_elements: sparklines, heatmaps, progress marks and restrained status dots
imagery.image_shape: 10–14px rounded rectangles aligned to the grid

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate state change plus short settling motion and reversible feedback
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: highlight appears instantly; active geometry glides between targets; contextual label/action reveals without reflow
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy start, soft landing, slight spring only for rare emphasis
interaction_feel.loading_style: reserve geometry; show local skeleton/progress only after 300ms
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate and uniform across all primary workflows

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain what will appear and provide one useful next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: state cause, preserve data, give one recovery action

overview.fallback_strategy: instant state transitions with no loss of meaning
overview.primary_technology: CSS transitions plus small stateful JavaScript

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll morphing in a productivity tool

text_effects.description: Only changing counters may roll vertically; changing labels crossfade in place

params.animation_per_unit: old value up, new value from below

image_effects.description: Photos gain a quiet overlay and action affordance on hover/focus

svg_animations.description: Chevron rotation, check stroke and selected icon fill only

visual_effects.composite_notes: The six reference patterns are a menu-design catalogue, not a requirement to ship six concurrent navigations. Life Ledger should borrow the sliding active geometry, inline disclosure, command palette, status feedback and numeric transitions. A floating dock or top mega panel may be prototyped only if it clearly improves a concrete workflow; do not mix them with the persistent sidebar.
